kind: memory read-layout probe; NOT a database benchmark
compiler:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.0.13.5)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin24.5.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
query_nodes: min(4096, node_count), shuffled; repeats bring each sample to 1048576 visits
result_validation: equal checksums for all variants in each layout/degree; raw sample medians checked
limitations: No B+Tree seek, disk I/O, writes, reverse index, transaction, durability, or allocator measured
Arrays and linked records share a prebuilt graph; lookup starts at precomputed heads/ranges
Query repetition warms the selected working set; visited distinct edges vary by degree
No CPU affinity, clock locking, isolated host, or statistical cross-process confidence bound
Probe covering records are 24-byte AoS, not the proposed grouped 16-byte SoA adjacency codec
